boundaries: Read-only observers never create, migrate or repair lifecycle databases. True absent historical stage rows remain unrecorded, not proof of past execution.

Present training must exactly COMPLETE; evaluation COMPLETE/SKIPPED. SQL BINARY comparison matches Python exact state strings even with historical NOCASE/RTRIM state-column collation. Other custom stage names gain no invented completion meaning.

Schema/duplicate identity checks and rows share one transaction; current exact PK avoids duplicate scans. Unique historical no-PK tables remain supported. This is not a general identity-collation or hostile DB security redesign.

Known per-task stage conflicts exclude only that completed candidate, while an exact bounded lifecycle request rejects the entire requested set on any requested conflict. Structural/duplicate identity errors reject the whole authority read.
Pipeline counts preserve audited global FSM semantics. Artifact/cache presence cannot override withdrawn completion qualification.
Notification is still a mutable metric mirror, not an immutable observation. It skips caller-owned transactions, rolls back only owned work on error, and does not promise atomicity with result files.
